title: Stage representatives of abelian inverse-image sections
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $j$, let $P_j$ be a precoverage on $F(j)$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with isomorphism covers, finite indexed composition and base-change stability [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and covering pullbacks. Assume every covering presieve has finitely many arrows. Each transition functor $F(a)$ maps covering presieves to covering presieves, preserves pullbacks of a covering arrow along any arrow, and is continuous for the generated topologies. Let $V$ be a cocone of $F$ whose object and arrow set cocones are colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Let $Q$ be a precoverage on $V.pt$ with the same finite closure, isomorphism and covering-pullback properties. Its covers are precisely transported images along the $V_j$ of stage covers. Assume each $V_j$ is continuous and preserves covering pullbacks. Fix $i\in J$, an abelian sheaf $G$ on $P_i$, and $U\in F(i)$. For each $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$ put $W_t=F(t.hom)(U)$ and let $A_t$ be the sections at $W_t$ of the inverse image of $G$ along $F(t.hom)$. Supply sheaf maps $\alpha_t$ from that inverse image to restriction along $V_{t.right}$ of the inverse image along $V_i$, satisfying the unit equations: for every $X\in F(i)$ the stage adjunction unit followed by $\alpha_t$ at $F(t.hom)(X)$ equals the $V_i$ adjunction unit at $X$ in the arrow category, including endpoints [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-site-abelian-section-diagram]. For every section $x$ of the inverse image along $V_i$ at $V_i(U)$, there are $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$ and $y\in A_t$ with $\alpha_t(W_t)(y)$ heterogeneously equal to $x$. Here heterogeneous equality is equality after transporting the underlying element type along the object equality $V_{t.right}(W_t)=V_i(U)$ given by cocone naturality. No diagram, cocone or colimit universal property is asserted.

proof.text: Form presentations of a limit object Y by stages reached from i, including arrows from i and stage objects with image Y. Joint surjectivity of the object and arrow colimit legs supplies representatives. Filteredness moves any finite set of representatives to a common stage. Eventual equality in these same two supplied colimit cocones gives equality of endpoints and composites after further refinement, and equalizes parallel refinements. Thus the presentation category is filtered. The category above a fixed presentation is final by the common-refinement and equalizer criterion.

Take the filtered colimit of the inverse-image sections on presentations. Lift a restriction arrow to a common stage; eventual equality and naturality of the uniquely unit-characterized transition maps prove independence of the lift and the identity and composition restriction laws. These are a presheaf of abelian groups. Every Q cover lifts by hQ to a finite stage cover, and hVpullback preserves its covering pullbacks. Its sheaf equalizer is the filtered colimit of the finite stage equalizers. Filtered abelian group colimits commute with finite products and equalizers, so the presheaf is a sheaf; the empty-cover condition gives the zero group.

A map from this constructed sheaf to a sheaf H is a compatible family of stage sheaf maps. Apply each stage adjunction to identify this family with one map from G to restriction of H along V_i. The identity presentation and the unit define the reverse assignment. Adjunct uniqueness and the colimit universal property show the assignments are mutually inverse and natural in H. Uniqueness of the left adjoint therefore identifies the constructed sheaf with the canonical sheafPullback, compatibly with units.

At Y = V i U, the presentations carrying U forward form a final subcategory indexed by Under i. Common refinements and eventual equality give the finality criterion. The unit-compatible comparison identifies its coprojections with the supplied alpha, since the h-alpha equations uniquely determine their adjuncts. Joint surjectivity in the filtered colimit of underlying sets gives t and y for any x. Cocone naturality transports the target group, and hence its underlying element type; HEq records exactly the resulting equality.

theorem colimit_site_abelian_section_representatives
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
      (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
      ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
        ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck
          Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : ∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app
        (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X)))
    (U : F.obj i)
    (x : ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
        (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U))) :
    ∃ (t : Under i)
      (y : ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj
          (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))),
      HEq ((α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)) y) x
